notes.text: Available in cPanel 94 and later. Operates on the selected account. The documented workflow starts a scan, polls getScanStatus until complete, lists infected files, lets the user choose each action, queues JSON disinfection and polls checkDisinfectionStatus. This client does not start or poll automatically. disinfectFiles is excluded pending JSON transport under whm-api-client-8x0.1.18.

Omit lastId to return the entire disinfection log; supplying the last received record ID returns only subsequent records and is recommended for polling performance. The source specifies an integer minimum of 1; values are forwarded without client-side range enforcement.

details preserves step, issue and done record fields: optional file, numeric id, message and state, with type required in every alternative. The pinned step/issue alternatives require state, while done requires only type. Existing object-union merging preserves all fields and common requiredness; it does not enforce a discriminator-dependent state rule. Numeric IDs may be integers or fractional numbers.

The status prose lists done, none, queued and running, while its formal enum lists done, queued and running. Keep the string contract without inventing a closed runtime enum. log is the disinfection log path; results do not initiate disinfection or fetch any file.

Available scan types depend on the administrator settings in Configure ClamAV. The pinned formal data schema is one object with optional id and message strings. id documents home, mail, public_html and public_ftp; the field descriptions describe one path/type record.

The initial 2026-10-31 capture observed a list of objects on both routes. Its sanitized root-mismatch paths mask leaf names, so they establish no named live field types. Preserve the formal object and also accept a list of the same documented optional id/message record as a source-based compatibility inference. No unknown live fields are added. Null and missing payloads remain invalid.

scanType is required: home scans the entire account home, mail the email directory, public_html the web directory and public_ftp the FTP directory. Availability depends on administrator configuration. Starts scanner work immediately; the source declares no rollback and the client neither retries nor rolls back.

Returns a nullable object without pinned fields. Preserve opaque fields and explicit null; an absent data member is a payload mismatch. No task ID or successful scan completion is inferred from this result.

exclude.reason: Requires an application/json request body with a dynamic actions object mapping infected-file paths to disinfection choices. JSON transport remains under whm-api-client-8x0.1.18; generic GET/form POST calls cannot represent this body. This operation is not deprecated.

evidence.note: Pinned /ClamScanner/disinfect_files POST requestBody/content/application~1json/schema/properties/actions is an object whose additionalProperties enum is cleanse_mailbox, delete, quarantine or ignore. The property names are absolute or account-home-relative file paths. x-readonly=false and x-rollback=none; preserve the JSON transport exclusion rather than inventing a scalar form serialization.
